verdict.rationale: React's own build-time tool, the React Compiler, has a documented debugging page that separates compiler errors (which occur at build time and block compilation) from runtime issues. React itself does not ship a dev server; the docs defer to third-party build tools like Vite, Parcel or Rsbuild. Nothing in the evidence shows how clear or actionable the error messages are. Missing for 10: a first-party dev server with error overlays, evidence that error messages are clear and actionable, and independent or hands-on corroboration of error quality.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get clear, actionable error messages from the dev server and build tool when something breaks

citations.quote: Compiler errors occur at build time and prevent your code from compiling... Runtime issues occur when compiled code behaves differently than expected.
